message.reasoning: We need probability that a randomly chosen flagged device (i.e., device that scanner flagged as infected) is actually infected. Given: total devices 100, infected devices = 20, uninfected = 80. Scanner detects 18 of the 20 infected => true positives = 18. It also flags 16 uninfected devices => false positives = 16. So total flagged = 18 + 16 = 34. Probability a flagged device is infected = 18/34 = 9/17. So answer B.
